app.name: Audorix.ChatX
app.tagline: Open-source communication, built in the open.
app.intro: Chat with contacts and colleagues, organize teams in workspaces and channels, share files, keep private chats that are never saved, and add a chat to your website. Self-hosted, with SQLite or PostgreSQL.
app.footer: Open source under the MIT License.

included.api: ASP.NET Core API with liveness and readiness checks
included.database: SQLite and PostgreSQL support with separate migrations
included.accounts: Accounts with email verification, password recovery and Google or Microsoft sign-in when configured

demo.title: Demo data
demo.intro: Adds 300 demo people, 50 companies, contacts, 150 groups, 800 channels, direct conversations, about 24,000 messages, activity (mentions, saved messages, reminders and scheduled messages: 500 items for you, 50–100 for everyone else) and 500 support conversations with replies and internal notes, and includes you in part of it: you become a support agent in your demo companies.
